scope: One host-only complete checkpoint assessment of one fixed lossless FP8 packet format before runtime implementation. No GPU, performance or numerical-contract change.
goal: Same real API d2/d3 committed Decode 1.5x–3x; exact scalar target state/logits/output, production unchanged.

hypothesis: Replace repeated raw FP8 byte reads by a lossless six-bit palette plus literal exceptions; original scalar FMA/reduction/publication remains unchanged. This removes traffic instead of substituting a costly matrix/certificate executor.
format: Per tensor top63 raw byte codes with deterministic count-descending/code-ascending ties; six-bit index63 escapes to one exact raw byte. Each128 weights has one32-bit exception-stream offset; warp ballots and popcount could locate literals without serial entropy state. Palette63 bytes per tensor. Packed indices96 bytes per128 weights. All raw codes including signed zero/NaN preserved. No compressed floating arithmetic.
assessment: Read every208 FP8 tensor from pinned checkpoint, hash source ranges and shards, count exact exceptions and complete encoded bytes including palette/offsets. Independently roundtrip a fixed128-weight packet sample from every tensor plus exhaustive all-code and boundary controls. No alternate palette/packet scan.
gate: Require at least20% total payload reduction before native decoding or owner implementation. Below this floor close the format before GPU; above it next bounded whole-executor package must include compact owner/decoder, preserve8GiB reserve, charge preparation, pass complete scalar-prefix and immediately return to real8K/40K d2 API. d3 only after useful d2.
